description: Defines a template class for a lock-free multi-producer multi-consumer concurrent queue based on moodycamel's implementation, including specializations for non-blocking and sleeping wait policies, with nested consumer classes and queue management methods.

classes.name: concurrent_queue
classes.description: A template class implementing a lock-free MPMC queue with non-blocking and sleeping variants, including methods for pushing, popping, and creating consumers.

classes.description: A nested class providing a consumer interface for the queue with try_pop and bulk pop methods.

classes.description: A nested class providing a consumer interface with try_pop, bulk pop, and blocking pop methods.
